title: Soviet’s New Working Week
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.answer: iv — Optimism of the great future
questions.answerKey: iv — Optimism of the great future
questions.prompt: Paragraph A題目真正問甚麼Matching Headings 要找的是整段主旨，不是段內出現過的某個名詞。Paragraph A 確實提到Five-Year Plan，但它的語氣重點是 Stalin 時代的宏大自信、快速工業化想像，以及全民投入新世界建設的樂觀氣氛。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “There are no fortresses that Bolsheviks cannot storm.”
沒有任何堡壘是 Bolsheviks 攻不下的。
“Unlimited enthusiasm was the mood of the day, with the Communists believing that iron will and hard-working manpower alone would bring about a new world.”
當時的氣氛是無限熱情；Communists 相信，單靠鋼鐵般的意志和勤奮的人力，就能創造一個新世界。
只看首尾句，這段已經很明顯地突出一種情緒：自信、雄心、樂觀和相信未來。中間的工業增長資料是用來證明這種氣氛有現實背景。
“weak and backward Russia was to turn overnight into a powerful modern industrial country”
弱小落後的 Russia 要在一夜之間變成強大的現代工業國家。
“production of coal, iron and steel increased at a fantastic rate”
煤、鐵和鋼的產量以驚人的速度增加。
這些句子共同指向「偉大未來的樂觀信念」。
這正好覆蓋 Paragraph A 的情緒和功能。Stalin 的 quote、turn overnight into powerful modern industrial country、fantastic rate、new world 全部都支援這個 heading。
排除 vi vi “Soviet Union’s five-year plan” 雖然也相關，但太像段內名詞。Paragraph A 不只是介紹五年計劃本身的政策內容，更在建立五年計劃背後的時代信念和狂熱氣氛。若只選 vi，會漏掉首尾句的self-confidence 和 unlimited enthusiasm。
方法總結Heading 題要問：「哪個選項能概括整段的功能？」不要只因為某個 heading 重複原文名詞就選它。

questions.prompt: Paragraph B題目真正問甚麼這題要找 Paragraph B 的整體主題。段落中有 Taylor、Ford、assembly line、Fordson tractors 和capitalist models，所以要判斷它們是同一個大概念，還是只是一連串例子。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “Enthusiasm spread to time itself, in the desire to make the state a huge, efficient machine in which not a moment would be wasted, especially in the workplace.”
這股熱情甚至延伸到時間本身，人們渴望把國家變成一部巨大而高效的機器，尤其在工作場所，不讓一刻被浪費。
“All this culminated in the Plan, which has been characterized as the triumph of the machine, where workers would become supremely efficient robot-like creatures.”
這一切最終在五年計劃中達到高峰；該計劃被形容為機器的勝利，工人會成為極高效率、近似機器人的存在。
首尾句顯示，這段主要講效率、時間管理、機器化工作和工人被塑造成高效生產者。
段落中間出現兩組外國來源：
Henry Ford 的流水線大規模生產。
“Emulating and surpassing such capitalist models formed part of the training of the new Soviet Man…”
模仿並超越這些資本主義模式，成為訓練新蘇維埃人的一部分。
Paragraph B 的效率觀念來自美國 Taylor 和 Ford。作者不是只講 Ford，還講 Taylor 的time-motion studies，以及資本主義工業模式如何被蘇聯吸收、模仿和超越。因此 xii 比 viii 更能概括全段。
排除 viii viii “The Ford model” 只覆蓋段落一部分。Ford 確實重要，但段落一開始也講 Taylor，後面概括成capitalist models。選 viii 會把其中一個例子誤當全段主題。
方法總結當段落列出多個人名或例子時，heading 通常要選能統一所有例子的上位概念。這裡的上位概念是 foreign inspiration。

questions.answer: ii — Making use of the once wasted weekends
questions.answerKey: ii — Making use of the once wasted weekends
questions.prompt: Paragraph D題目真正問甚麼這題要概括 Paragraph D。段落講 Yuri Larin 的提議、Stalin 批准、媒體宣傳和政府命令。要找的是這個提議的核心內容，不只是人物或政治流程。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “Hardly had that policy been announced, however, when Yuri Larin, who had been a close associate of Lenin and architect of his radical economic policy, came up with an idea for even greater efficiency.”
然而，前一政策剛宣布不久，Yuri Larin 便提出一個追求更高效率的想法；他曾是 Lenin 的親密夥伴，也是其激進經濟政策的設計者。

“In August, the Council of Peoples’ Commissars ordered that the continuous workweek be brought into immediate effect, during the height of enthusiasm for the Plan, whose goals the new schedule seemed guaranteed to advance.”
到了八月，人民委員會下令 continuous workweek 立即生效；當時正值五年計劃熱情高漲，而新時間表似乎必定能推進計劃目標。
首尾句顯示，這段講一個更高效率的新工作週方案如何提出並被政府推行。
真正控制 heading 的句子是：

“Workers were free and plants were closed on Sundays. Why not abolish that wasted day by instituting a continuous workweek so that the machines could operate to their full capacity every day of the week?”
工人在星期日休息，工廠也關門。為何不取消這個被浪費的一天，推行 continuous workweek，讓機器一週每天都能滿負荷運作？
“Making use of the once wasted weekends”
利用原本被視為浪費的週末。
原文的 “abolish that wasted day” 直接對應 heading 中的 “once wasted weekends”。這段的主旨就是把星期日從休息日變成生產日，讓機器一週七天運作。
排除其他 headings xi “Establishing a three-shift system” 屬於 Paragraph C 的內容，題目已給 C 的 example。
x “The colour-coding scheme” 是 Paragraph E 的細節。
vii “abolition” 是後面制度失敗和取消，不是 D 段的新制度開始。
方法總結Heading 題要留意問句。Paragraph D 的 “Why not abolish that wasted day…” 是全段發展的核心，因此 heading 也要圍繞 wasted Sunday / weekend。

questions.prompt: Paragraph E題目真正問甚麼這題要找 Paragraph E 的整段主題。段落很長，包含五天週、假日削減、休息日輪換、工人分組、顏色日曆和例外行業。Heading 要能概括這個新工作週的實際安排。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The idea seemed simple enough but turned out to be very complicated in practice.”
這個想法看似相當簡單，但實際操作起來非常複雜。
“In all cases, though, Sunday was treated like any other day.”
不過，在所有情況下，星期日都被當成任何普通日子一樣處理。
首尾句顯示，這段解釋制度實行的複雜方式，並強調 Sunday 失去特殊地位。
看段內最具標誌性的安排
“Workers in each establishment … were divided into five groups, each assigned a colour which appeared on the new Uninterrupted Work Week calendars distributed all over the country.”
每個機構中的工人被分成五組，每組分配一種顏色；這些顏色出現在發往全國的新Uninterrupted Work Week 日曆上。
“Colour-coding was a valuable mnemonic device since workers might have trouble remembering what their day off was going to be…”
顏色編碼是一種有用的記憶工具，因為工人可能難以記住自己的休息日會是哪一天。
Paragraph E 最突出的實行機制就是 colour-coding。五組工人、不同輪休日、日曆顏色，全都服務於這個 scheme。雖然段落也提到五天週和六天週例外，但 colour-coding 是最能代表新制度操作方式的 heading。
排除 ii ii “Making use of the once wasted weekends” 更適合 Paragraph D，因為 D 段講取消 wasted Sunday 的構想。Paragraph E 已經進入具體 implementation，重點轉向如何安排工人輪休。
方法總結長段落中有很多細節時，要找「最能把多個細節組織起來的機制」。這裡是 colour-coding，而不是單一假日或單一工時安排。

questions.answer: i — Benefits of the new scheme and its resistance
questions.answerKey: i — Benefits of the new scheme and its resistance
questions.prompt: Paragraph F題目真正問甚麼這題要判斷 Paragraph F 是宣傳 benefits，還是講 objection / resistance。細讀會發現兩者都有，而且段落後半把焦點轉向家庭和宗教。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “Official propaganda touted the material and cultural benefits of the new scheme.”
官方宣傳大力吹捧新制度在物質和文化方面的好處。
“Religion succumbed, but the family, as even Stalin finally had to admit, proved much more resistant.”
宗教屈服了，但家庭，甚至 Stalin 最後也不得不承認，證明更有抵抗力。
首句是 benefits，尾句是 resistance。首尾句合起來，基本已鎖定 heading i。
看 benefits 和 resistance 的分佈
“Workers would get more rest; production and employment would increase…”
工人會得到更多休息；生產和就業會增加……
“Leisure time would be more rationally employed…”
閒暇時間會被更合理地利用……然後出現 objection：
“Benefits of the new scheme and its resistance”
新制度的好處及其遇到的抵抗。
這個 heading 同時覆蓋首句的 material and cultural benefits，以及尾句的 family proved much more resistant。若只選 benefits，會漏掉段落後半；若只選 resistance，也會忽略大部分官方宣傳內容。
段落中 religion 和 family 很明顯，但不能只用它們選 “Reaction from factory workers and their families”。Paragraph F 主要是官方宣傳和制度意圖，真正講工人和家庭實際反應的是 Paragraph G。
方法總結遇到首句和尾句方向不同的段落，heading 常常要同時包住兩端。這題選 i，正因它同時有benefits 和 resistance。

questions.answer: ix — Reaction from factory workers and their families
questions.answerKey: ix — Reaction from factory workers and their families
questions.prompt: Paragraph G題目真正問甚麼Paragraph G 前半講制度擴散數字，後半講實際問題。Heading 要看轉折後的重點，尤其是工人和家庭如何受到影響。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The continuous work week, hailed as a Utopia where time itself was conquered and the sluggish Sunday abolished forever, spread like an epidemic.”
continuous work week 被歡呼為一個征服時間、永遠廢除遲鈍星期日的烏托邦，並像 epidemic一樣擴散。
“Confusion reigned: the new plan was introduced haphazardly, with some factories operating five-, six- and seven-day weeks at the same time, and the workers often not getting their rest days at all.”
混亂佔了上風：新計劃被胡亂推行，有些工廠同時運作五日、六日和七日週，工人甚至常常拿不到休息日。
首尾句顯示，這段由官方式烏托邦宣傳，轉向混亂和工人困境。
“Most serious (though never officially admitted), the workers hated it.”
最嚴重的是，雖然官方從未承認，工人痛恨它。
“Coordination of family schedules was virtually impossible and usually ignored…”
協調家庭時間表幾乎不可能，通常也被忽視。
“rest days were empty without any loved ones to share them…”
沒有親人一起度過，休息日變得空洞。
“Reaction from factory workers and their families”
工廠工人及其家庭的反應。
Paragraph G 最強的實際反應是 workers hated it，以及家庭時間無法協調。這與 ix 完全吻合。前半官方數字只是背景，真正轉折後的段落焦點在工人生活和家庭關係受破壞。
排除 i i 已經用於 Paragraph F，且 F 段講官方宣傳的 benefits 和 social resistance。G 段講實際推行後的工人痛恨、家庭錯開和休息日空洞，情緒更具體。
方法總結Heading 題遇到 “In fact / By then / though” 之類轉向詞，要特別看後半。Paragraph G 的核心在

questions.answer: v — Negative effects on the production itself
questions.answerKey: v — Negative effects on the production itself
questions.prompt: Paragraph H題目真正問甚麼這題要找 Paragraph H 的主要問題是 social life 還是 production。首句已經把工人不滿和production 分開，指出這段要講新制度對生產本身的負面效果。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The Soviet government might have ignored all that (it didn’t depend on public approval), but the new week was far from having the vaunted effect on production.”
蘇聯政府也許可以無視那些問題，因為它不依賴公眾認可；但新工作週遠遠沒有達到宣稱的生產效果。
“Workers lost a sense of responsibility for the special tasks they had normally performed.”
工人失去了對自己平常負責的專門任務的責任感。
首尾句都指向 production / work quality / responsibility，所以段落主題很集中。
“Machines, no longer consistently in the hands of people who knew how to tend them, were often poorly maintained or even broken.”
機器不再穩定由懂得照料它們的人操作，因此常常維護不良，甚至損壞。
這句直接說明新制度傷害生產設備和生產流程。
對生產本身的負面影響。
Paragraph H 沒有再詳細講夫妻朋友休息日不同，重點已轉到 production：輪班複雜、工作隊伍做不同工作、機器維護差、工人失去責任感。因此 v 是最準確 heading。
容易把 H 和 G 混淆。G 講 workers hated it 和 family schedules；H 進一步說，即使政府可無視民怨，生產也沒有變好。這個轉折 “but” 是定位 heading 的關鍵。
方法總結Heading 題要留意段落是否從社會問題轉入經濟問題。Paragraph H 的核心詞是 production、machines、responsibility。

questions.answer: vii — The abolition of the new work-week scheme
questions.answerKey: vii — The abolition of the new work-week scheme
questions.prompt: Paragraph I題目真正問甚麼這題問最後一段的主旨。Paragraph I 是時間線段落，要看制度從 lose ground 到 abandoned 的過程。
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “As a result, the new week started to lose ground.”
結果，新工作週開始失勢。
“A bold but typically ill-conceived experiment was at an end.”
一個大膽但典型地構思不周的實驗結束了。
首尾句清楚顯示，這段講新工作週制度走向終結。
段落中間的時間線包括：
“Stalin’s speech of June 1931 … marked the beginning of the end.”
Stalin 1931 年 6 月的演說標誌著結束的開始。
“Finally, in 1940 … both the continuous five-day week and the novel six-day week were abandoned…”
最後，到 1940 年，continuous five-day week 和新式 six-day week 都被放棄。
“Sunday returned as the universal day of rest.”
星期日恢復為普遍休息日。
“The abolition of the new work-week scheme”
這完全概括 Paragraph I。先失勢，再被六日週取代，最後五日 continuous week 和六日週一起被abandoned，Sunday 恢復為 universal day of rest。
排除其他 headings v “Negative effects on production” 屬於 Paragraph H。I 段雖然承接 H 的失敗原因，但主要內容是政策撤回和制度終止。
方法總結最後段若有多個年份，要問這些年份共同組成甚麼發展線。這裡的線索是 lose ground →beginning of the end → abandoned → at an end。

questions.prompt: According to paragraph A, the Soviet Union’s Five-Year Plan was a success because
questions.translation: 根據 Paragraph A，蘇聯五年計劃成功，是因為甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目真正問甚麼這題問的是 Paragraph A 中「成功」的證據。題目不是問 Stalin 說過甚麼，也不是問 Russia 原本如何落後。它要找實際結果，即五年計劃帶來了甚麼可見成效。
“There are no fortresses that Bolsheviks cannot storm.”
沒有任何堡壘是 Bolsheviks 攻不下的。
“Unlimited enthusiasm was the mood of the day, with the Communists believing that iron will and hard-working manpower alone would bring about a new world.”
當時的氣氛是無限熱情；Communists 相信鋼鐵般的意志和勤奮的人力能帶來一個新世界。
Paragraph A 的功能是介紹五年計劃的自信、工業化成就和時代樂觀。成功的證據應在中間的結果句。
原文沒有直接說 success because，但有一組結果：
“Between 1928 and 1932, production of coal, iron and steel increased at a fantastic rate, and new industrial cities sprang up, along with the world’s biggest dam.”
1928 至 1932 年間，煤、鐵和鋼的產量以驚人的速度增加，新工業城市也冒起，還有世界上最大的水壩。
這句中的核心主語是 “production of coal, iron and steel”，核心動詞是 “increased”，程度是 “at a fantastic rate”。這是最直接的工業成果。五年計劃的目標是把落後 Russia 變成 powerful modern industrial country，而工業產量大幅上升正好證明這個目標取得成果。
A “Bolsheviks built a strong fortress.”錯。fortresses 是 Stalin quote 中的比喻，不是實際建築或成功原因。
B “Russia was weak and backward.”錯。weak and backward 是五年計劃開始前的狀態，不是成功結果。
C “industrial production increased.”正確。對應 “production of coal, iron and steel increased at a fantastic rate”。
D “Stalin was confident about the Soviet Union’s potential.”錯。Stalin 的 confidence 是氣氛和宣傳口吻，不能作為計劃成功的實際證據。
“production of coal, iron and steel increased at a fantastic rate”
改寫關係：工業產量驚人增長 = 工業計劃取得成功的具體證據。
方法總結MCQ 題不要把 quote 當作事實答案。Paragraph A 的 quote 用來展示氣氛，真正證明 success的是 production increased。

questions.prompt: Daily working hours were cut from eight to seven to
questions.translation: 每日工時由八小時減至七小時，目的是甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目真正問甚麼這題問縮短工時的真正用途。題目中的 “to” 表示目的，要找原文中的 scheme / purpose /increase production，而不是只看表面上改善工人生活的說法。
“Yet this was a Communist system whose goals had always included improving the lives of the proletariat.”
然而，這是一個目標一直包括改善無產階級生活的 Communist system。
“This meant that the factories were open day and night and that many had to work at highly undesirable hours.”
這意味著工廠日夜開放，許多人不得不在非常不理想的時間工作。
首句看似工人福利，尾句卻講不理想工時。這提示我們：縮短工作日表面像福利，實際和生產安排有關。
“One major step in that direction was the sudden announcement in 1927 that the working day would be reduced from eight to seven hours.”
朝著那個方向的一個重大步驟，是 1927 年突然宣布工作日將由八小時減至七小時。
“Typically, though, the state took away more than it gave, for this was part of a scheme to increase production by establishing a three-shift system.”
然而，典型的是，國家拿走的比給予的更多；因為這是透過建立三班制來增加生產的計劃的一部分。
答案取決於 “for this was part of a scheme to increase production”。這裡 this 指前面的 reduced working day 和相關安排。也就是說，縮短每日工時並非單純福利，它被納入一個提高生產的制度：三班制讓工廠日夜運作。
A “improve the lives of all people”太廣也太表面。原文說 Communist goals included improving proletariat lives，但後面 though 修正方向，而且不是 all people。
B “boost industrial productivity.”正確。boost = increase；industrial productivity 對應 production。
C “get rid of undesirable work hours.”相反。結果是 many had to work at highly undesirable hours。
D “change the already established three-shift work system.”錯。原文說 establishing a three-shift system，不是改變已建立的制度。
“were cut from eight to seven to…”
“part of a scheme to increase production”
boost = increase；industrial productivity = production in factories / industry。
方法總結遇到 “though” 要特別小心。Paragraph C 先給福利表象，後用 though 指出國家真正的生產目的。

questions.answer: A — they were pressured by the state to do so.
questions.answerKey: A — they were pressured by the state to do so.
questions.prompt: Many factory managers claimed to have complied with the demands of the new work week because
questions.translation: 許多工廠經理聲稱已遵守新工作週要求，是因為甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目真正問甚麼這題問 factory managers 為何只是 claimed，而沒有真正 applying it。要找的是他們為何需要表面合規。題目中的 claimed 很重要，表示有「聲稱」和「實際推行」之間的落差。
“The continuous work week, hailed as a Utopia where time itself was conquered and the sluggish Sunday abolished forever, spread like an epidemic.”
continuous work week 被歡呼為一個征服時間、永遠廢除遲鈍星期日的烏托邦，並像 epidemic一樣擴散。
“Confusion reigned: the new plan was introduced haphazardly, with some factories operating five-, six- and seven-day weeks at the same time, and the workers often not getting their rest days at all.”
混亂佔了上風：新計劃被胡亂推行，有些工廠同時有五日、六日和七日週，工人甚至常常拿不到休息日。
這段功能是從快速推廣轉向實際混亂。factory managers 的 “claimed” 就在這個實行混亂的背景中。
“In fact, many managers simply claimed that their factories had gone over to the new week, without actually applying it.”
事實上，許多經理只是聲稱自己的工廠已轉用新工作週，卻沒有真正實行。
“Conforming to the demands of the Plan was important; practical matters could wait.”
符合五年計劃的要求很重要；實際問題可以先放一邊。
“Conforming to the demands of the Plan was important” 是答案核心。Plan 是由國家推動的政治經濟計劃，所以 managers 需要顯示自己符合上級要求。原文沒有直接寫 “pressured by the state”，但 “demands of the Plan” 清楚表明制度壓力來自國家計劃。
A “they were pressured by the state to do so.”
正確。這是 “Conforming to the demands of the Plan was important” 的概括。
B “they believed there would not be any practical problems.”錯。原文說 practical matters could wait，意思是實際問題被延後處理，不是沒有問題。
C “they were able to apply it.”錯。原文說 without actually applying it。
D “workers hated the new plan.”這是同段後面的事實，但不是 managers claimed compliance 的原因。
“Conforming to the demands of the Plan was important”
改寫關係：五年計劃的要求 = 國家制度壓力；聲稱合規 = 表面上回應這種壓力。
方法總結看到 claimed，要檢查原文是否有 contrast：claimed X, without actually Y。答案通常藏在下一句的原因或解釋。

questions.prompt: Whose idea for a continuous workweek did Stalin approve and help to implement?
questions.translation: Stalin 批准並協助推行的 continuous workweek 是誰的想法？

blocks.text: “Hardly had that policy been announced, however, when Yuri Larin, who had been a close associate of Lenin and architect of his radical economic policy, came up with an idea for even greater efficiency.”
前一政策剛宣布不久，Yuri Larin 便提出一個追求更高效率的想法；他曾是 Lenin 的親密夥伴，也是其激進經濟政策的設計者。
“In August, the Council of Peoples’ Commissars ordered that the continuous workweek be brought into immediate effect…”
到了八月，人民委員會下令 continuous workweek 立即生效。
首尾句顯示，Paragraph D 正是 continuous workweek 想法的提出和推行段。
“Soon after, though, he got the ear of Stalin, who approved.”
不久之後，他獲得 Stalin 的注意，而 Stalin 批准了這個想法。
這裡的 “he” 回指前文的 Yuri Larin。
“Yuri Larin … came up with an idea for even greater efficiency.”
Yuri Larin 提出了一個追求更高效率的想法。
因此，Stalin 批准的是 Yuri Larin 的 idea。
答案 Yuri Larin 兩個字，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.prompt: What method was used to help workers remember the rotation of their days off?
questions.translation: 用甚麼方法幫助工人記住輪流休息日？

blocks.text: “The idea seemed simple enough but turned out to be very complicated in practice.”
這個想法看似簡單，但實行起來非常複雜。
“In all cases, though, Sunday was treated like any other day.”
不過，在所有情況下，星期日都被當作普通日子。
Paragraph E 主要講新制度如何操作，包括工人如何知道自己的休息日。
“Colour-coding was a valuable mnemonic device since workers might have trouble remembering what their day off was going to be, for it would change every week.”
顏色編碼是一種有用的記憶工具，因為工人可能難以記住自己的休息日會是哪一天，因為它每週都會改變。
題目問 method，原文直接說 “Colour-coding was a valuable mnemonic device”。mnemonic device 是記憶工具。它幫助工人用顏色查看日曆，知道哪一天休息。
答案 Colour-coding 來自原文，一個 hyphenated word，符合字數限制。

questions.prompt: What was the force most resistant to the new workweek scheme?
questions.translation: 對新工作週制度抵抗力最強的是甚麼力量？

blocks.text: “Official propaganda touted the material and cultural benefits of the new scheme.”
官方宣傳大力吹捧新制度在物質和文化方面的好處。
“Religion succumbed, but the family, as even Stalin finally had to admit, proved much more resistant.”
宗教屈服了，但家庭，甚至 Stalin 最後也不得不承認，證明更有抵抗力。
首尾句已直接顯示答案位置，尤其最後一句有 “proved much more resistant”。
原文把兩個潛在威脅並列：
有組織宗教和核心家庭。
“Religion succumbed, but the family … proved much more resistant.”
宗教屈服了，但家庭更有抵抗力。
所以最有抵抗力的是 the family。答案兩個字，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：全文段落地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句用 Stalin 的話 “There are no fortresses that Bolsheviks cannot storm” 展示蘇聯五年計劃的強烈自信；末句說當時瀰漫 unlimited enthusiasm，Communists 相信意志和人力能創造新世界。只看首尾句，可以先看到這段主要建立時代氣氛：蘇聯相信自己能快速由落後國家變成現代工業強國。中間的煤、鐵、鋼、工業城市和大壩都是這種樂觀氣氛的成果證明。
首句說這股 enthusiasm 甚至擴展到 time itself，目標是在工作場所不浪費一刻；末句說整個 Plan被形容為 machine 的勝利，工人會變成高效率、近似機器人的存在。首尾句顯示，這段主要講蘇聯如何受外國效率思想影響，尤其是 Taylor 的時間動作研究和 Ford 的流水線模式。重點不只是Ford 一人，也包括美國式工業效率對蘇聯新工人的想像。
首句以 Yet 開頭，說這畢竟是宣稱要改善 proletariat 生活的 Communist system；末句說工廠日夜開放，許多工人被迫在極不理想的時間工作。只看首尾句，可以先看到一個矛盾：表面上縮短工時似乎是福利，實際安排卻服務於更高產量。這段功能是解釋七小時工作日和三班制如何連在一起，所以題目已給 example：heading iii。

首句說 Yuri Larin 在前一政策剛宣布後，提出更高效率的新想法；末句說政府下令 continuous workweek 立即生效，因為這個新時間表似乎能推進五年計劃目標。首尾句顯示，這段主要講「取消星期日休息」的構想如何出現並獲 Stalin 支持。中間反覆圍繞 Sunday、wasted day、machines full capacity，所以核心 heading 應該概括「利用原本被視為浪費的週末」。
首句說這個想法看似簡單，實行起來卻很複雜；末句說所有情況下，Sunday 都被當作普通日子。只看首尾句，可以先知道這段會解釋新制度的具體操作。中間講五天週、四天工作一天休息、工人分成五組、每組一種顏色、按 calendar 看休息日。雖然也有例外安排，但最具標誌性的內容是colour-coding，用顏色幫工人記住輪休日。
首句說官方宣傳大力吹捧新制度的 material and cultural benefits；末句說 religion 讓步了，但family 甚至 Stalin 最後也承認更有抵抗力。首尾句顯示，這段先列出政府聲稱的好處，再轉向制度遭遇的社會阻力。中間提到休息、生產、就業、生活水平、文化活動、購物、宗教和家庭。全段主題不是單一好處，而是宣傳中的好處和來自家庭生活的反作用力。
首句說 continuous work week 像 epidemic 一樣擴散，被宣傳為征服時間、永遠廢除 sluggish Sunday 的烏托邦；末句說新計劃混亂推行，有些工廠同時有五、六、七日週，工人甚至拿不到休息日。首尾句顯示，這段由制度快速推廣轉到實際混亂和工人痛恨。中間最強焦點是家庭時間失調：夫妻、朋友休息日不同，休息日變得空洞。
首句說蘇聯政府可能會無視工人不滿，因為它不依賴 public approval，但新工作週對生產也沒有達到宣傳效果；末句說工人失去了對自己原本專門任務的責任感。首尾句顯示，這段主題很集中：問題不只在私人生活，也直接傷害 production。中間提到複雜輪班令工人每週做不同工作，機器不再由熟悉的人照料，結果維護變差甚至損壞。

首句說 as a result，新工作週開始失勢；末句說這個 bold 但 ill-conceived experiment 結束。首尾句顯示，這段是收尾段，講制度如何逐步被放棄。中間按時間線交代 Stalin 1931 年批評depersonalised labour，政府推廣六日週，continuous schedule 比例下降，最後 1940 年五日continuous week 和新式六日週都被取消，Sunday 恢復為 universal day of rest。
